article_title: What happens if the internet goes down? BlackSky - the UK's emergency backup plans

tasks.prompt: What is the central idea of the article?
options: A prolonged loss of power and communications could cascade through essential services, so the UK and BBC are planning backup systems for at least three days
The UK has decided to close every FM radio station immediately
Lancaster's 2015 flood affected only television reception
Satellite internet has already made emergency planning unnecessary
tasks.correct_answer: A prolonged loss of power and communications could cascade through essential services, so the UK and BBC are planning backup systems for at least three days
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מראה כיצד אירוע Black Sky עלול לשבש מערכות חיוניות רבות ומפרטת היערכות ממשלתית ושל ה־BBC לשלושה ימים לפחות.

tasks.prompt: Which communication systems continued to work during the 2015 Lancaster blackout?
options: Mobile apps and cash machines
Copper-wire landline telephones and FM radio
Online newspapers and railway signals
5G networks and streaming television
tasks.correct_answer: Copper-wire landline telephones and FM radio
tasks.explanation_hebrew: במהלך ההפסקה בלנקסטר שרדו טלפונים קוויים על חוטי נחושת ורדיו FM, בעוד מערכות דיגיטליות רבות כשלו.

tasks.prompt: How is the BBC preparing its emergency radio service?
options: By relying entirely on home broadband
By moving every employee to one satellite vehicle
By equipping a special studio for about 100 staff with secure non-internet communications and supplies for at least three days
By replacing all radio towers with mobile phones
tasks.correct_answer: By equipping a special studio for about 100 staff with secure non-internet communications and supplies for at least three days
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ה־BBC מתכנן אולפן חירום לכמאה עובדים, עם קווים שאינם תלויים באינטרנט ומלאי דלק, מים ומזון לשלושה ימים לפחות.

tasks.prompt: Why does the emergency plan rely on FM radio?
options: FM uses no electricity at transmission sites.
Every smartphone can transmit an FM signal.
FM broadcasts require no prepared messages.
FM can reach almost everywhere even when the internet or mobile networks fail.
tasks.correct_answer: FM can reach almost everywhere even when the internet or mobile networks fail.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: רדיו FM נבחר משום שהוא יכול להמשיך להגיע לקהל גם בהפסקת חשמל רחבה או במתקפת סייבר שמשבשת רשתות דיגיטליות.

tasks.prompt: What are the planned High Altitude Pseudo-Satellites intended to provide?
options: At least a week of emergency mobile-phone and internet connectivity when ground networks fail
Permanent electricity for every UK home
A replacement for all water pumps
Weather forecasting only for Lancaster
tasks.correct_answer: At least a week of emergency mobile-phone and internet connectivity when ground networks fail
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הממשלה משקיעה 70 מיליון ליש״ט במטוסים שיחוגו מעל בריטניה ויספקו לפחות שבוע של קישוריות סלולרית ואינטרנטית בחירום.

tasks.prompt: What does the phrase “nine meals from anarchy” suggest in this context?
options: Emergency meals should contain nine ingredients.
Civil disorder begins whenever shops close for one hour.
About three days without food or essential supplies could turn a crisis into chaos.
The government plans to provide nine meals to every household.
tasks.correct_answer: About three days without food or essential supplies could turn a crisis into chaos.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: תשע ארוחות מייצגות בערך שלושה ימים; הביטוי מדגיש כמה מהר מחסור במזון ובשירותים עלול לערער את הסדר.

tasks.prompt: Describe five knock-on failures caused by the Lancaster power cut.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין חמש תוצאות שונות ולהראות שהן נבעו מאובדן החשמל.
expected_points: Homes lost light and heat.
Some water supplies failed because pumps needed electricity.
The railway station closed.
Petrol stations and shops closed.
Most cash machines stopped working.
Traffic lights failed.
Mobile reception and normal digital communications became difficult or unavailable.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article argue that greater efficiency and connectivity can reduce resilience?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד תלות הדדית וצמצום מערכות גיבוי יוצרים נקודות כשל משותפות, עם דוגמה מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Efficient systems often remove older parallel backups and spare capacity.
More services now depend on electricity, the internet or mobile networks.
A failure in one network can therefore spread to water, payments, transport, shops and communications.
Replacing radio-based emergency-service communications with mobile technology may create another shared dependency.
The planned closure of copper landlines removes a system that once worked during power cuts.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the Black Sky risk, the lessons from Lancaster and the main UK backup plans in 5–6 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את הגדרת הסיכון, דוגמת לנקסטר, יעד של 72 שעות, תכנית ה־BBC, HAPS והחשש מאובדן מערכות ישנות.
expected_points: A Black Sky event is a prolonged disruption in which power loss causes multiple essential systems to fail.
Lancaster showed how water, transport, retail, payments and digital communications can collapse together.
Resilience planning aims to keep the country functioning for at least 72 hours.
The BBC plans an emergency FM service with independent communications, generators and supplies.
HAPS aircraft are being developed to provide temporary mobile and internet connectivity.
The closure of copper landlines and uncertain future of FM may remove technologies that currently provide valuable redundancy.

tasks.prompt: Evaluate the article's final contrast between modern digital systems and older technologies as emergency backups.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח טענה מאוזנת, להשתמש לפחות בשתי דוגמאות מן הכתבה ולהתייחס ליתרונות ולמגבלות של מערכות ישנות וחדשות.
expected_points: Explain why digital systems are efficient in normal conditions but may share dependencies on power and networks.
Use Lancaster's surviving copper landlines or FM radio as evidence for older systems' resilience.
Mention a modern backup such as HAPS, satellite phones or 4G and 5G emergency-service technology.
Recognise limitations such as aging copper infrastructure or FM's high power use.
Conclude whether the UK should preserve mixed, independent communication channels.
